title: The BIAS Detection Framework: Bias Detection in Word Embeddings and Language Models for European Languages
benchmark_measurement: Detection of social stereotypes related to religion, as one of nine categories of social bias measured by the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
findings: This paper describes a framework that incorporates the CrowS-Pairs dataset to detect social biases, including those related to religion. However, the paper itself does not present specific findings or results regarding religious bias; it focuses on the architecture of the detection framework.
